description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for a Tic Tac Toe game backend, including endpoints for creating a game, making moves, retrieving game state, and listing game history. It interacts with database models, handles game logic, and emits WebSocket events for real-time updates.

classes.name: CreateGameRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new game, includes optional player identifiers.

classes.name: CreateGameResponse
classes.description: Response model for game creation, includes game id, initial board, status, and players.

classes.name: MoveRequest
classes.description: Request model for submitting a move, includes player symbol, identifier, and position.

classes.name: MoveResponse
classes.description: Response model after a move, includes updated board, move number, status, and winner.

classes.name: GameStateResponse
classes.description: Response model for current game state, including board, moves, players, status, and winner.

classes.name: GameHistoryListResponse
classes.description: Response model listing past completed games.

classes.name: GameHistoryEntry
classes.description: Entry for a finished game, including game ID, finish time, result, and move count.

methods.name: create_game(req: CreateGameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new game session with optional players, sets up initial game state.

methods.name: make_game_move( game_id: int, req: MoveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles a move request, validates the move, updates game state, persists move, and emits WebSocket events.

methods.name: game_state(game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches current game state, moves, players, and status for a given game ID.

methods.name: get_game_history(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of completed/archived game results and history.

ctags.name: make_game_move
ctags.signature: ( game_id: int, req: MoveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
